title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S – Map, Plots & Payment Plan
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S with the dedicated map, plot sizes, payment guidance, current availability, development checks and buyer verification.
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S is a residential sector within FT-II with a dedicated sector plan and multiple plot-size categories.

Buyers should use the Sector S plan to verify the exact plot, road and surrounding layout, then confirm current price, payment terms, development and availability before booking. Plot sizes commonly range from 5.56 marla to 1 kanal.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S overview

Sector S is part of Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II and has its own dedicated sector plan.

It should be evaluated as a separate Phase 2 sector rather than assuming it follows the exact pricing, development or payment structure of Sector P, Sector T or another nearby area.

For buyers, the most useful checks are:

- exact plot number
- plot size
- street and road position
- current development
- payment status
- outstanding charges
- total payable amount
- physical access

The dedicated Sector S plan should be the starting point for any serious comparison.

## Sector S location and map

Use the dedicated Sector S plan to understand the sector layout and match a specific property to its road and surrounding land use.

For the exact plot, confirm:

- plot number
- street or road
- plot dimensions
- nearby open space
- commercial or community areas
- corner or non-corner position
- road width
- access from the wider Phase 2 network

Do not rely only on a cropped dealer screenshot.

Ask for the full Sector S plan together with a marked location for the specific plot.

## How to read the Sector S plan

Start with the full Sector S PDF.

Then identify the exact plot and check:

- road position
- internal street layout
- surrounding plots
- green or open areas
- commercial references
- community-use areas
- wider sector access

If the PDF is difficult to read on mobile, request a zoomed image showing the exact plot while keeping the full plan available for context.

A plan is useful for orientation, but it should be paired with current on-ground verification before payment.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector S

Current Sector S project-focused material lists the following residential plot categories:

- 5.56 marla – approximately 25 x 50
- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10.89 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14.22 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

These sizes are consistent with several other Phase 2 residential sectors.

However, availability should be checked for the exact size you want rather than assumed from an old plan or price sheet.

## Sector S plots for sale

Sector S inventory may include different transaction types.

Depending on current availability, a buyer may encounter:

- fresh booking
- installment inventory
- fully paid inventory
- resale property
- partially paid inventory
- inventory with outstanding charges

Before comparing two properties, establish which category applies.

A lower asking price may represent a plot with unpaid installments or other outstanding charges.

## Sector S payment plan

Current Sector S-focused material publishes an installment-based structure and also refers to a lump-sum discount.

The published residential categories currently show the following indicative total prices:

| Plot Size | Indicative Total Price |
| --- | ---: |
| 5.56 Marla | PKR 3,495,000 |
| 8 Marla | PKR 4,665,000 |
| 10.89 Marla | PKR 6,065,000 |
| 14.22 Marla | PKR 7,585,000 |
| 1 Kanal | PKR 10,155,000 |

These figures should be treated as a current market/project reference, not as a permanently guaranteed Sector S rate.

The source also publishes a 20% lump-sum discount structure, but the exact installment cadence for Sector S should still be confirmed before booking.

## Payment checks before booking

Before making payment, request a written breakdown showing:

- total plot price
- registration fee
- down payment
- remaining balance
- installment schedule
- development charges
- possession charges
- location premium
- transfer or processing charges
- taxes
- lump-sum discount, if applicable

Do not rely only on an old payment-plan image.

The written current payable amount is more important than a historic screenshot.

## Sector S prices

There is no single guaranteed price for all Sector S inventory.

The final amount can vary according to:

- plot size
- exact location
- road width
- corner position
- main-road location
- green-facing or open-facing position
- payment completion
- outstanding dues
- development status
- seller urgency

If a property is resale inventory, compare the seller's asking price with the remaining developer balance before judging the true cost.

## Special-location charges

Special-location premiums may apply where a property has a preferred position.

Possible categories can include:

- corner
- main road
- wider road
- park-facing
- green-facing
- open-front
- other premium location

Ask for the exact loading or premium in writing.

A base price alone does not always show the final payable amount.

## Sector S development status

Development should be verified on the ground.

Do not assume that every part of Sector S has reached the same development stage.

During a site visit or live video check, look for:

- road formation
- road carpeting
- drainage or sewerage work
- utility infrastructure
- plot demarcation
- street marking
- surrounding construction
- machinery or active work
- physical access to the sector

If a seller claims a specific possession or development status, ask for current evidence for the exact plot.

## How to review a Sector S plot

A practical review should follow this order:

1. Confirm Sector S.
2. Obtain the exact plot number.
3. Match it with the dedicated sector plan.
4. Check plot size and dimensions.
5. Review road and street position.
6. Confirm payment status.
7. Check outstanding dues.
8. Confirm special-location charges.
9. Inspect current development.
10. Calculate total payable amount.

This avoids comparing two properties that are not financially or physically equivalent.

## Sector S vs Sector T

Sector S and Sector T should be compared separately.

Do not assume that neighboring sectors have the same:

- plot sizes
- payment terms
- development
- current inventory
- access
- pricing

Use each sector's dedicated plan and compare like-for-like plot sizes.

If Sector S offers a size or location that Sector T does not, that may matter more than a small difference in headline price.

## Sector S vs Sector P

Sector P currently has a clearer published commercial offer and branding as The Caladan.

Sector S should not simply copy Sector P's current full-payment structure.

When comparing the two, use:

- same plot size
- final payable amount
- installment flexibility
- road position
- current development
- premium location charges
- intended holding period

The stronger choice depends on the buyer's objective.

## Who Sector S may suit

Sector S may suit buyers who want:

- a dedicated Phase 2 sector plan
- multiple residential plot sizes
- installment or full-payment comparison
- a sector-specific location rather than general Phase 2 inventory
- the ability to compare neighboring sectors before booking

It may be less suitable for someone who needs immediate possession or a fully established resale environment.

Those requirements should be verified before booking.

## Is Sector S good for investment?

Sector S may be considered as part of a broader Phase 2 investment comparison, but the individual property matters more than the sector label.

Evaluate:

- entry price
- plot size
- exact location
- development
- payment schedule
- outstanding balance
- resale demand
- competing Phase 2 inventory
- total acquisition cost

Do not rely on guaranteed-return claims.

## Sector S site-visit checklist

During a visit, check:

- exact plot
- road width
- route into the sector
- plot level
- drainage
- surrounding development
- street condition
- corner or premium status
- nearby open or commercial areas
- physical accessibility

For remote buyers, request a live video walkthrough, current pin and marked Sector S plan.

## Do not confuse Sector S with Phase 1

Sector S on this page refers specifically to Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II.

Phase 1 uses block terminology such as Block A, Block B, Block B-1 and Block C.

Always confirm:

- project phase
- sector
- plot number
- map reference

before comparing prices or sending payment.
